name: io.github.zscaler/zscaler-mcp-server
description: An MCP server that provides interaction with the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform.

environmentVariables.name: ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Zscaler OneAPI client ID used to authenticate against the Zero Trust Exchange.

environmentVariables.name: ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Zscaler OneAPI client secret used to authenticate against the Zero Trust Exchange.

environmentVariables.name: ZSCALER_VANITY_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Zscaler OneAPI vanity domain for the tenant.
